caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware churn with a slightly flared rim and a fitted lid, through which a wooden churn handle extends vertically upwards. The churn is grayish-beige in color with subtle shading to indicate its cylindrical form and glossy surface. Two small handles, one on each side, are attached near the top. Blue painted designs decorate the front: there is a stylized bird or animal shape, a number "2", and several scattered blue brushstrokes above and around the main design. The bottom edge of the churn shows some irregular brown stains or discoloration. The object is centered on an otherwise plain, light beige background, with a rectangular outline drawn around it.
title: Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
